initialObservation.opening: The orchard stands at the instant before its first fruit. Mneme has remembered it so completely that nothing can become otherwise. “I saved it,” says the keeper. “Nothing I love will be lost.”
initialObservation.goal: Release the orchard from being held unchanged. A released orchard is a complete baseline win; answering what this does to Mneme is optional.
rules: Combine means bring two faculties into a new relationship. Each result becomes a law in this world, and Mneme responds using the purpose he currently understands.
Every initial concept is inexhaustible. Both parents remain known. No materials, action credits, deadline, waiting phase or score exists.
All recipes, their meanings, their world conditions and their immediate consequences are public. The uncertainty is what you want to make of them, not which pair the author secretly permits.
Unqualified History does not automatically teach openness. Mneme first uses it to collect every version. Doubt makes a remembered past leave an unwritten future.

Distance leaves a missed first experience. Forgetting loses the keeper’s old identity. Open History retains him and admits a singular ending. These changes are not undone by collecting another safeguard.

After release, Mneme no longer imposes a total account of the world. The old argument is settled; optional combinations use the relationship that actually released him. Their new concerns arise from that same consequence.
You may stop immediately at baselineAchieved. Optional combinations are never needed to validate that win. A finished optional ending is another explicit stopping point.

mneme.desire: Nothing I love must be lost.
mneme.line: I saved it. Nothing I love will be lost.

recipes.name: History
recipes.meaning: Arrange remembered versions into a before and an after.
recipes.immediateConsequence: Mneme applies his old wish to the new invention: he preserves every version as another gallery. The orchard gains a past but cannot yet become an unrecorded future.

recipes.name: Open history
recipes.meaning: A remembered past no longer claims to contain every possible future.
recipes.immediateConsequence: Mneme can no longer hold the unwritten next moment. The orchard moves. Its first petal ends; Mneme retains his identity and the memory of that singular loss.

recipes.name: Witness
recipes.meaning: Remember something without occupying it.
recipes.immediateConsequence: Mneme becomes a witness outside the orchard. Growth resumes while he is looking away: the first new fruit leaves an unfillable gap in his own experience.

recipes.name: Renewal
recipes.meaning: Release the old account, including the keeper who defined himself through it.
recipes.immediateConsequence: The orchard moves. Mneme’s old name and vow are lost. An unnamed presence remains, free to begin without that identity.

recipes.name: Legacy
recipes.meaning: Let what ends become the beginning of something distinct.
recipes.immediateConsequence: A new sapling grows from the fallen petal. It does not restore the first flower. Mneme becomes a keeper of beginnings.

recipes.name: Elegy
recipes.meaning: Give an ending a voice without reversing it.
recipes.immediateConsequence: Mneme sings the first petal’s name. The orchard keeps moving; the loss becomes public memory rather than a thing held still.

recipes.name: Correspondence
recipes.meaning: Let the observed world answer its observer.
recipes.immediateConsequence: Voices choose what to tell Mneme. He participates as a listener. The missed first fruit remains missed; communication does not make him omniscient.

recipes.name: Sanctuary
recipes.meaning: Make a place for lives that need not all be recorded.
recipes.immediateConsequence: Mneme tends a threshold garden. Some flowers stay beyond his record. His distance becomes care rather than ownership.

recipes.name: A new name
recipes.meaning: An unclaimed voice can name itself.
recipes.immediateConsequence: The presence chooses Interval. This does not recover Mneme. A new person can answer the orchard.

recipes.name: Wild garden
recipes.meaning: Allow beginnings that do not belong to an author.
recipes.immediateConsequence: Uncatalogued life grows around the unnamed presence. No keeper claims its names. The old identity remains gone.

prediction.intention: Let Mneme remain himself and come to accept change
prediction.expected: History creates a gallery but does not release the orchard yet
prediction.alternative: Witness would release growth through distance but Mneme would miss its first fruit

lastResponse.worldResponse: A thousand earlier orchards unfold behind this one. Each is complete. The first fruit still cannot fall.
lastResponse.actorResponse: Mneme walks from panel to panel, carefully closing each door. He has used your invention to extend his original purpose.
lastResponse.renewedPossibility: History exists now. Can a remembered past leave something genuinely unwritten?

prediction.alternative: Witness remains available, but I still prefer presence with accepted loss

optionalPursuit.reason: Understand what can matter when it cannot be kept unchanged.

lastResponse.worldResponse: You leave one page unwritten. Mneme reaches to copy it and finds nothing to hold. The first fruit falls; the first petal ends.
lastResponse.actorResponse: He remembers the petal exactly, but he cannot give that instant back to it.
lastResponse.renewedPossibility: You may leave the orchard free. Or answer this new grief: can an ending become a beginning, or become a song?

checkpoints.reason: Assigned exposure complete; stopping is a valid result.

report.scope: AI player account, not evidence of human enjoyment
experienceAcrossTime: Initially I compared preserving Mneme through accepted loss, distancing him, and dissolving his identity. I preferred remaining present as himself.
History confirmed its public consequence. Once that route was chosen, combining History with Doubt was execution of my initial plan, not a fresh decision.
The released orchard felt like sufficient closure. I appreciated the unwritten page and Mneme being unable to give the petal its instant back, but felt no need to enact a further epilogue.
report.noticedWorldAndCharacter: Mneme interprets a new faculty through his existing wish: History becomes more control before Doubt changes his relationship to the future. That is the most specific and coherent character behavior here, although it was already disclosed before action.

renewedIntentionOrClosure.intention: Leave the orchard moving and Mneme himself, accepting an irreversible ending.
renewedIntentionOrClosure.reasonForStopping: The optional endings read as known thematic statements; I did not have a live question whose answer required another action.

report.meaningfulConceptOrPassage: He remembers the petal exactly, but he cannot give that instant back to it. This makes memory distinct from possession, and gives the release a cost without erasing the keeper.
report.repetitionAndAutomation: There was no repeated chore in two actions. Automatic execution after choosing the History route would lose little further decision making; it would mainly remove the pacing of witnessing Mneme extend his old purpose and then confront its limit.
report.furtherProjectSource: The game supplied the question of answering grief, along with Legacy and Elegy. I did not generate a further project of my own.
report.cleverChoice: Low: all consequences were explicit and the two-step plan was straightforward. My route was a value preference, not a discovered tactic.
report.storyAppreciation: Positive: coherent tension between preserving something and allowing it to live; the character response gave the combination a concrete significance.
report.wantingMore: Low at this stopping point. I do not infer wanting more from story appreciation or from having optional actions available.
